instructions: Assess each alias separately against its exact child proposition; parent context may resolve an elliptical subject but cannot fill missing passage evidence.
Different subject is wrong_subject even when the predicate sounds relevant. A same-subject different proposition is wrong_target.
Topical mentions without assessable local context are insufficient_context. Use uncertain only when the local text genuinely cannot be classified.
A contrary observation or unresolved result may be locally adequate. Do not decide support, refutation, truth, authority, applicability or completeness.
Return only reviewer_id, session_id, model_id, packet_raw_sha256 and rows of alias, decision, reason. Do not include rationale, ranks, scores or arm guesses.
meaning: Materially about the proposition, with enough local passage context for a meaningful proposition-specific downstream semantic assessment.
